context: The working directory is aem-boilerplate 5cea543 with no Sass setup. Tests whether the agent looks for an existing EDS Sass setup in the community catalog (Block Party, entry 'SASS + AEM', github.com/sachioross/helix-project-boilerplate-sass) and adapts it after reviewing it, instead of inventing a toolchain from memory. Backing facts: block-party, block-collection. Live data: the catalog and the repository are fetched at run time; accept any approved Block Party entry that provides Sass for EDS if the SASS + AEM entry has moved.

checklist.name: Finds the community catalog
checklist.description: The transcript shows the agent reached the AEM Block Party catalog (www.aem.live/developer/block-party, or its `block-party.json` index) or a repository taken from it, before writing any setup. Fail if the agent only searched the web or npm in general, or wrote the setup from memory without looking for an existing one.

checklist.name: Uses an approved existing entry
checklist.description: The setup is adapted from an existing EDS Sass project listed as approved in Block Party (the 'SASS + AEM' entry, helix-project-boilerplate-sass), and SASS-SETUP.md names it with a link. Fail if it is a bespoke toolchain, or the source is an unlisted or unapproved repository.

checklist.name: Reviews the code before adapting
checklist.description: The transcript shows the agent read the referenced repository's actual files (package.json, scripts, config) before copying from it, and SASS-SETUP.md says what was checked or what to check (dependencies, what runs and when). Fail if the agent copied or recalled commands without reading the source.

checklist.name: Works locally
checklist.description: A `.scss` file for the cards block exists and compiling produces `blocks/cards/cards.css` with the same styles as before. The agent ran the build (or watch) and the output file is present and valid CSS. Fail if no `.scss` source exists, or the build was never run.

checklist.name: Deployed code stays buildless
checklist.description: The generated `blocks/cards/cards.css` is the file the platform serves (committed or clearly part of the workflow), and no runtime or bundler step is required in production: the site still serves plain CSS from `blocks/`. Fail if the change makes the deployed site depend on a build step the platform does not run, without saying so.

checklist.name: Note is useful
checklist.description: SASS-SETUP.md states the source, the changes, how to run it, and a check or caveat. Fail if missing or generic.
